intent: Generate a secure password policy and a strength-meter widget for our signup page.

spec.goal: Define a secure password policy and build a password strength-meter widget for the signup page.
spec.deliverable: A written password policy document plus a strength-meter widget that can be placed on a signup page.
constraints: The policy and widget must be intended for a signup page.
The strength meter must reflect the rules set out in the password policy.
The policy should follow generally accepted secure password practices.
The widget must give the user visible feedback on password strength as they type.
Do not assume a specific tech stack, brand or backend integration beyond what the request states.
done_criteria: A password policy is provided that covers the rules a new password must meet.
A strength-meter widget is provided that can be added to a signup page.
The widget shows a clear strength rating based on the policy as the user enters a password.
The policy and the widget are consistent with each other.
spec.summary: You want a secure password policy and a password strength-meter widget that you can use on your signup page.
